messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "dose given IV slowly over 1 to 2 minutes"
set: ["dose given IV slowly over 1 to 2 minutes", "40 mg IV slowly over 1 to 2 minutes", "4 mg IV over 2 to 5 minutes", "0.1 mg/kg IV over 2 to 5 minutes", "slowly over the day", "given as a bolus infusion over 15 minutes", "first dose infused over 15 minutes", "IV dose can also be given postoperatively", "first parenteral dose infused over 15 minutes", "increase dose slowly", "if treatment needs to stop, prescriber will lower dose gradually over 1 to 2 weeks", "1 to 2 week intervals", "IV dose should be given immediately before induction of anesthesia", "first oral dose given 30 minutes before start of chemotherapy", "IV dose should be undiluted", "first parenteral dose given 30 minutes before start of emetogenic chemotherapy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
